instanceMethods.name: Perform
instanceMethods.signature: (L: gp_Lin, Prm: number, Tol: number, F: TopoDS_Face): void
instanceMethods.comment:
Perform the intersection between the segment L(0) ... L(Prm) and the Shape <Sh>.
Only the point with the smallest parameter on the line is returned.
The Tolerance <Tol> is used to determine if the first point of the segment is near the face. In that case, the parameter of the intersection point on the line can be a negative value (greater than -Tol).

instanceMethods.name: IsDone
instanceMethods.comment: True is returned when the intersection have been computed.

instanceMethods.name: HasAPoint
instanceMethods.comment: True is returned if a point has been found.

instanceMethods.comment: Returns the U parameter of the intersection point on the surface.

instanceMethods.name: VParameter
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the V parameter of the intersection point on the surface.

instanceMethods.name: WParameter
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the parameter of the intersection point on the line.

instanceMethods.name: Pnt
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the geometric point of the intersection between the line and the surface.

instanceMethods.name: Transition
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the transition of the line on the surface.

instanceMethods.name: State
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the state of the point on the face. The values can be either TopAbs_IN ( the point is in the face) or TopAbs_ON ( the point is on a boundary of the face).

instanceMethods.name: Face
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the significant face used to determine the intersection.
